# Rob Ward

Rob Ward is the current Deputy of [District 5](https://flow.je/elections/district-5) and a member of [Reform Jersey](https://flow.je/elections/parties/reform-jersey). He was first elected to the States of Jersey in 2018.

Rob Ward has participated in 2 elections since 2002:

- [**2018 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/rob-ward#e42)

  Elected as Deputy of St Helier No 2 with 42.9% of the ballot.

  - [2018 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2018/rob-ward/)
  - [2018 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Tk6XVrjlaww)
  - [2018 Bailiwick Express Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZYHp3R3cN_0)
- [**2022 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/rob-ward#e48)

  Elected as Deputy of District 5 with 61.1% of the ballot.

  - [2022 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2022/robert-ward/)
  - [2022 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2CTX5ZfyolY)

Rob Ward has declared his intention to stand in the upcoming [2026 Connétables Election](https://flow.je/elections/2026) in [St Helier](https://flow.je/elections/st-helier), representing [Reform Jersey](https://flow.je/elections/parties/reform-jersey). \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/03/21/who-will-win-the-battle-for-st-helier-reform-launches-bid-to-take-the-town/)\]
